description: This file defines Swagger API documentation schema classes for the Notes API resource in the Fineract project. It includes request and response schemas for creating, updating, and deleting notes related to resources, such as clients or offices.

classes.name: NotesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains static nested classes defining the Swagger schemas for the Notes API endpoints.

classes.name: PostResourceTypeResourceIdNotesRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a note request, contains a 'note' string field.

classes.name: PostResourceTypeResourceIdNotesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a note, includes officeId, clientId, resourceId.

classes.name: PutResourceTypeResourceIdNotesNoteIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for updating a note, includes officeId, clientId, resourceId, and nested changes with note content.

classes.name: DeleteResourceTypeResourceIdNotesNoteIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for delete note response, contains resourceId.

methods.name: NotesApiResourceSwagger
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation, as this class only contains static nested classes.
